name: A Faded Journal Page
summary: In eastern Elwynn, an old page lies unread in Marshal Haggard's home, tied to Stalvan Mistmantle's grim history.

sections.title: Parchment in the Chest
sections.body: For years, the Faded Journal Page lay in an old trunk at Marshal Haggard's home near Elwynn Forest's eastern border. Haggard had retired there, but failing eyesight kept him from reading the weathered parchment. The page remained neglected until investigators seeking the truth about Stalvan Mistmantle retrieved it.

sections.title: The Trail to Darkshire
sections.body: Unable to read the brittle writing, Marshal Haggard sent investigators across the river to the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Duskwood. Tavernkeep Smitts examined the page and recognized the handwriting. It tied the page to the grim saga that haunts the region.

faq.q: Where is the Faded Journal Page found?
faq.answer: The page is found in an upstairs chest in a house near Marshal Haggard, in eastern Elwynn Forest by the river boundary with Duskwood.

faq.q: Why couldn't Marshal Haggard read the page himself?
faq.answer: Age has so weakened Marshal Haggard's eyesight that he can no longer make out the faded writing.

faq.q: Who recognizes the handwriting on the journal page?
faq.answer: Tavernkeep Smitts, the barkeep at the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire, recognizes the handwriting when he examines the page.

faq.q: What protects the chest containing the page?
faq.answer: A hostile Forlorn Spirit attacks anyone who opens the upstairs chest, before the page can be examined safely.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, you can use this forgotten record to help solve a mystery troubling townsfolk on both sides of the river between Elwynn and Duskwood.
